title: Discover event rows and the header search field show a keyboard focus ring (SCAN-1022)
detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-22. --fq-focus-ring is a colour, so box-shadow:var(--fq-focus-ring) computed to none and .dx-ev:focus-visible had removed the outline too: keyboard users saw no indicator on Discover event rows or the Discover search field. Both now draw a 2px outline; .fq-sin:focus-within gives the header search field a ring. scripts/frequency-focus-ring.test.ts fails on a bare box-shadow focus colour. The audit's finding 2 (Commons muted and faint contrast) was already fixed in app/themes/frequency.css (the :not(.dark) override), so no token change.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const d=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/site-discover.css','utf8');const k=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/kit-site.css','utf8');const bad=[];if(/box-shadow\s*:\s*var\(--fq-focus-ring\)/.test(d))bad.push('discover uses the focus colour as a shadow');if(!k.includes('.fq-sin:focus-within'))bad.push('header search has no focus ring');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-1022: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when a Discover control paints its focus colour as a box-shadow, or the header search loses its ring.
